name: POST /api/auth/login - Exchange credentials for a session token
description: Validates credentials against the local identity projection and returns a signed LeadFlow session token, stamping last_login. Exchanging credentials is an action rather than a resource creation, so it answers 200 rather than 201. Unauthenticated by design - it is part of the auth bootstrap. A missing account and a wrong password both answer INVALID_CREDENTIALS, and the handler compares against a dummy hash when the account is unknown so response timing cannot be used to enumerate registered emails. QA: depends on register, which creates the account; the email resolves from register's captured auth.register.response.data.user.email key. MUST-46 note: the password resolves from the test_password config variable deliberately - a password appears in no response body, so no endpoint can produce it and no captureResponse can capture it. That is the genuine producer-less case the rule permits, and a password is not an entity id, so the VAR-FOR-FK antipattern does not apply. The variable is declared per environment so a dev secret is never carried into staging or production.

testCases.name: Log in with the registered account

errorCases.when: email or password is missing or blank
no account holds that email, or the password does not match
the credentials are correct but the account has been deactivated
